## About Chad Lewine

Chad began working with computers at age 3. His parents worked from home, so he had access to computers starting in the early 90s. He learned the basics on early website building platforms like Tripod, Homestead, Geocities, NetObjects, Dreamweaver, and Flash.

Chad built his first website at age 9 for his Tae Kwon Do school. He designed and sold his first website for a Philadelphia-area author in 2002 for $75—he was 12 years old.

In 2010, Chad graduated from The Art Institute of Pittsburgh with an A.S. in Web Design and Interactive Media. He moved to Brooklyn in 2011 for an entry-level SEO job at a growing agency in Manhattan, then began freelancing full-time shortly after.

Chad lived in NYC from 2011-2019 pursuing passions of music and art, with freelance web design as his sole livelihood. In 2021, he returned to his hometown of North Wales, PA and rebranded as chadworks.

### Hourly Rate Tiers (by Annual Revenue)

| Client Type | Standard | Discounted* |
|-------------|----------|-------------|
| Passion projects | $135/hr | $110/hr |
| Volunteer-run orgs (no paid staff) | $175/hr | $135/hr |
| Revenue under $500K | $225/hr | $150/hr |
| Revenue $500K - $999K | $275/hr | $225/hr |
| Revenue $1M+ | $350/hr | $300/hr |

*Discounted rates may apply based on hours purchased or other factors.

### Day Rate

75% of your applicable hourly rate for 6 working hours (9am - 9pm Eastern). Ideal for blitz work on web design, graphic design for events/pitches, website cleanup, brochure edits, new sales pages, or email automation builds.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### General

**Q: How much does a website cost?**
A: Fees vary depending on the scope of the project. Most websites fall into the $3,200 - $6,200 range, but higher and lower fees are still common. One-page websites start at $1,200, and author websites start at $850.

**Q: Do you offer payment plans?**
A: Yes. Pay-monthly websites are available for $95-$175/month with no large upfront cost. Custom projects may have payment plan options—ask during consultation.

**Q: How long does it take to build a website?**
A: Timeline depends on project scope and client responsiveness with content and feedback. Pay-monthly websites can be up in 5-7 days after assets are submitted.

**Q: What platform do you build on?**
A: Expertise includes WordPress (with Avada theme), Squarespace, Shopify, and Wix. WordPress is recommended for most projects due to flexibility and power.

**Q: What is WordPress?**
A: WordPress is free, web-based software that handles all the complicated code and technologies that manage the moving pieces of a website's back end. Over 40% of all websites on the internet are built on WordPress.

**Q: What WordPress theme do you use?**
A: The framework/theme used is called Avada. It's for WordPress, but not made by WordPress. It is the #1 third-party WordPress theme.

**Q: Will I be able to update my own website?**
A: Yes. One hour of tutorial time is included in most new website builds, showing you how to change text and images and giving a brief tour of the WordPress dashboard.

**Q: Do you provide analytics?**
A: Every site comes with Google Analytics installed upon launch. This is the industry standard tracking platform and is free.

### SEO

**Q: What is SEO?**
A: SEO (search engine optimization) is a digital marketing strategy that helps website pages organically rank higher on search engines like Google.

**Q: How is SEO different from paid ads?**
A: With paid ads, visibility stops when you stop paying. With SEO work, you can continue to show up long after you've paid for the SEO work on your website.

**Q: How long does SEO take to work?**
A: SEO is a long-term strategy. Results typically begin appearing within 3-6 months, with continued improvement over time.

### Pay-Monthly Websites

**Q: What's included in pay-monthly websites?**
A: Modern design, mobile optimization, basic SEO, technical support, fast loading speeds, security, and all updates/upgrades handled for you. Includes 30 minutes of changes each month.

**Q: Can I eventually own my pay-monthly website?**
A: Yes, there's an option to buy the site so you own it and don't have to keep paying monthly.

**Q: Is there a contract?**
A: Month-to-month plans have no commitment—cancel anytime. Lease plans (6, 12, 24, 36 months) have the commitment reflected in lower monthly rates.
